items.title: Keep dog on leash (max. 2m) and muzzled outside own fenced property
items.quote: Nach dem Gesetz über das Halten von Hunden ordne ich deshalb an, dass Sie Ihren Hund außerhalb Ihres eingefriedeten Grundstücks ab sofort an einer höchstens zwei Meter langen Leine führen und ihm einen Maulkorb anlegen.
items.computation: The order takes effect "ab sofort" (immediately). The earliest plausible start is the letter's own date, 2025-07-02, though compliance in practice can only begin once the recipient actually has the letter in hand (likely a few days after posting). No end date is given; the order remains in force until a Wesenstest (behavioural test) proves otherwise, so there is no fixed due date for compliance itself — it is an ongoing obligation starting immediately upon receipt.

items.title: File Widerspruch against the leash/muzzle order
items.quote: Gegen diese Anordnung ist innerhalb eines Monats nach ihrer Bekanntgabe der Widerspruch beim Amt Musterflens-Land, Amtsweg 1, 24983 Beispielhusby, gegeben – schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: Letter dated Wed 02.07.2025, sent by ordinary post by a German authority. Under § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG it counts as delivered (bekannt gegeben) on the 4th day after posting, i.e. Sun 06.07.2025 (this day does not shift for weekends under this specific rule). Per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the one-month Widerspruch period starts the following day, 07.07.2025, and ends one month later per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB on Wed 06.08.2025. That day is a normal business day in Schleswig-Holstein, so no further shift applies. Final deadline for the Widerspruch to reach the Amt: 2025-08-06.

warnings: The letter orders an immediate leash-and-muzzle obligation ("ab sofort") with no stated end date other than a future behavioural test (Wesenstest) proving otherwise — the recipient should seek clarification on how and when such a test can be arranged if they wish to end the restriction.

Filing a Widerspruch does not automatically suspend the order unless stated otherwise; the leash/muzzle requirement likely applies even while a Widerspruch is pending, since the letter gives no indication of suspensive effect being granted.
